name: How should I prepare my bathroom for molding installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my bathroom for molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installers arrive, clear personal toiletries, towels, rugs, and decorative items off countertops, shelves, and floor edges. Ensure there is clear, unobstructed access to the bathroom and space for the carpenter to bring in tools and materials. If your project includes replacing old molding, point out any prior plumbing leaks, loose tiles, or soft drywall spots so underlying moisture damage can be inspected and repaired before the new trim is attached.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear personal items from the room, clear a pathway for tools, and note any soft drywall or prior leaks that should be checked before new trim goes up.
